title: Orders and replenishment
intro: Review replenishment needs, approvals and suppliers.
scope: This store · up to 50 records per page. Search and export cover only the loaded page.
unavailable: Unable to retrieve or confirm. Keep the pending operation and check again.
expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
denied: You do not have access to this operation.
missing: Record not found in this store.
conflict: The situation changed or an operation already exists. Refresh and review.
locks: This browser cannot safely coordinate writes across tabs. Use an updated browser.
locked: Another tab is saving. Wait and check again.
pending: Resolve the pending operation before creating another.
readonly: Read access is available. Writes require permission and an active Orders subscription.
storage: Unable to read the saved operation on this computer. New writes are blocked.
pendingHelp: The original operation is preserved on this computer. Check before retrying; opening this screen does not create an order.
order_missing: Order not found yet. You can retry the same operation.
supplier_uncertain: This supplier still needs confirmation. Retrying preserves the original data.
missingResult: Operation not found yet. Check again or explicitly retry.
discarded: Attempt discarded. This action did not change any balance.
supplierHelp: Commercial record for this store. Does not create an account or invite the supplier.
approvalHelp: No approval on this page? Calculate and approve replenishment in the Replenishment tab.
confirmHelp: Review the details below. Saving starts only when you confirm.
orderHelp: Each order contains one product. Creating a local order does not send it, pay or receive stock.
policyHelp: Target must exceed minimum. Unit-based products cannot have fractions.
noPolicy: Set minimum and target before calculating.
stale: Balance or policy changed · recalculate before approval
reviewHelp: A person decides. Approval does not send an order or authorize payment.
leave: There are unsent changes. Leave and discard these fields?
refreshHelp: Updated on this request; not real-time monitoring.
supplierConfirmed: Supplier confirmed. Refresh or browse pages to select it.
technicalHelp: Orders and replenishment use existing local APIs. Pending attempts store only the necessary command per company, store, device and user, without passwords or tokens. They survive logout for recovery.
retryConfirm: Retry the original operation? Identifiers and data will be preserved.
discardConfirm: Discard this unconfirmed attempt? Uncertain results cannot be discarded.
